name: Single-Leg Dumbbell Calf Raise
description: Standing on one leg with a dumbbell in the other hand and a hand on a wall for balance, rise onto the ball of the foot, then lower slowly.

source.title: ExRx: Dumbbell Single Leg Calf Raise
source.note: Described in our own words. Stick-figure approximation.

setup: Stand on one leg beside a wall, a hand on it for balance.
Hold a dumbbell in the other hand by your side.
cues: Rise as high as you can.
Stand tall; don't lean on the wall.

prescription.note: Start with 5 repetitions on each leg 3 times a day and build up to 20 repetitions 5 times a day.

keyframes.name: Stand on your left leg
keyframes.cue: Weight on the left foot, right foot lifted behind you.

keyframes.name: Rise onto your toes
keyframes.cue: Slowly lift your left heel until you're on the ball of the foot.
